title: MCP (Model Context Protocol): how agents reach tools, and where you can stop them
summary: The documented controls, commands and licensing statements are supported by Microsoft sources. The automatic path and endpoint warnings are formatting or placeholder mismatches, not incorrect controls. The page also preserves the documented disagreements about federated write actions and Work IQ defaults.
